text:
Priya: Quick heads-up: Orbis dedicated pool launch next Friday. They've committed to 55k tokens/min but asked if we can keep tail latency tight. Need quick plan: quota verify, autoscale tuning, a shadow load + a 30m canary, and an enablement session. Who's in?

Marco: I'm on it. I'll validate the quota mapping and double-check GPU slot assignments. Any fragility in their network?

Sam: I'll own autoscale policy. Suggest starting with 'stepwise-eco' (min 4 nodes, scale step +2 with 45s cooldown). Will run bench to tune thresholds.

Jules: I'll coordinate enablement + feedback capture. We should record the call and add a short NPS + 3 prompt examples at the end. Also flag renewal risk: their CSM flagged concern about cost-overruns in month 1.

AutoscaleBot: [09:04] policy-check: 'stepwise-eco' simulated for 20m window -> expected meet at 55k, average scale latency 42s.

Priya: Good. Marco confirm quota at cloud-provider level? Last time we hit an egress cap with Orbis.

Marco: Noted. Their cloud ticket still shows ingress/egress at default 20Gbps. I pinged their infra. Without bump we may see throttles above ~35k tokens/min.

Sam: For load testing I'll use wrk with a payload mix (short prompts 70%, long context 30%). Example command:

```
wrk -t12 -c400 -d10m -s scripts/orbis.lua https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```

Lua script will set token-length spread. Expected ~3.5k rps at c400 for short prompts.

AutoscaleBot: [09:18] load-preview: ramp profile 'sawtooth-10m' queued.

Jules: Enablement plan: 30m with ops + app team. Cover routing rules, fallback to 'redwood-lite', cost controls, and how to read the Console. I'll draft a 6-slide runbook.

Priya: Two risk items: (1) Renewal risk - Orbis asked about monthly committed credits; they want a cost forecast for first 90 days. (2) Onboarding status - their SRE still hasn't provided test credentials for internal metrics. Jules, can you capture those on the enablement ticket?

Jules: Yep. I'll add both: request forecast from finance template + ask Orbis SRE for metrics creds.

Sam: Running shadow test now. Will watch P50/P95, 5xx, and autoscale events. If P95>150ms for short prompts, we'll tweak batch settings.

OpsBot: [09:33] note: backup fallback 'redwood-lite' available in same region. Auto-rollback threshold configured at 0.6% 5xx over 5m.

Marco: Orbis infra replied: they've opened a support ticket to raise egress to 80Gbps, ETA 48h. They also supplied test VPC endpoints. Passing to Marco for validation.

Sam: Shadow Test #1 results: sustained token rate 49k/min, P95 short=112ms, P95 long=360ms (we're above target for long). 5xx=0.05%. Autoscale stepped up by +2 nodes twice, cooldowns respected. Logs: https://logs.internal/txn/4730001234/shadow1

Jules: Long-context latency is a concern. Suggest enabling 'kv_prefetch' for long-context requests and reducing batch_max by 15% for those paths. I'll add to runbook as conditional config.

Priya: Also we should instrument tracing for the first 48h after cutover and schedule a combined on-call (SRE + Eng) overlap. Marco, can you confirm node recovery playbook?

Marco: Recovery playbook ready. I'll attach the node-replace commands and test scripts. I'll also run a node-drain during the next shadow to validate no client-visible errors.

AutoscaleBot: [09:55] canary: 3% traffic route created for model 'redwood-dedicated-orbis'. Canary monitors: latency, errors, cpu util, and queue length.

Sam: Canary tuning note: reduce scale-in aggression during golden hour, set scale-in cooldown to 5m to avoid flapping.

Jules: Enablement invite scheduled Wed 11:00 PT. I'll include recording + follow-up NPS + short survey link. Also setting expectation: renewal touchpoint scheduled at week 6 to review cost vs usage.

Priya: Owners: Marco=quota & infra validation, Sam=autoscale + load tests, Jules=enablement + feedback capture, Priya=overall program owner + renewal cadence.

Marco: I'll run node-drain test in 30m and post results.

Sam: I'll run shadow #2 with kv_prefetch enabled and reduced batch_max. Posting results to logs link when done.

Jules: Added a feedback template: 4 quick questions + 3 free-text prompts for problematic cases. Will share before the enablement call.

Priya: Great. Final ask: if Orbis infra egress isn't raised by EOD, push the go-live by 48h. I don't want early throttling to risk renewal.

Marco: Agreed. I'll confirm egress status by 17:00 PT and update thread.

Sam: Shadow #2 started. Will update in channel.

AutoscaleBot: [10:22] shadow-2: kv_prefetch enabled, expected long-path P95 drop ~20%. Simulation running.

Priya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene tomorrow 09:00 PT for a final greenlight.
